note: Danh mục claims sơ bộ T3 Gibraltar (phiên Tiền kỳ, 15/10/2026). Trích nguyên văn từ tệp tải bằng curl (phiên chính + phiên phụ nguồn lịch sử). "nhay_cam" = claim chạm chủ quyền/thuế/thời sự, phải theo QUAN-TRI-RUI-RO VÀNG. Chưa qua kiểm mù/REVIEWER (việc của G1).
khong_dung: 6,8 km² (Teardown) — không có nguồn chính thức; dùng C20
ngày 4/8/1704 và 8/6/1969 — nguồn mâu thuẫn; nói "1704", "June 1969"
"the fence came down on 15 July" — xem C03
"over half of the workforce" như sự thật — chỉ là lời UK Gov (C09b)
"tax haven" như khẳng định của kênh
"southernmost point of Europe" (khán giả sửa sai ở DW)
số nhà cái được cấp phép (gamblingdivision.gov.gi 403)

claims.claim_en: The UK and the EU signed a treaty on Gibraltar in Brussels on 14 July 2026.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: following the signing of the historic UK-EU Treaty on Gibraltar in Brussels today (14 July)

claims.claim_en: Since 15 July 2026 the land border runs without routine checks; people arriving by air or sea face two checks, Gibraltar's and Spain's on behalf of the EU.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Persons arriving at these entry points will first be subject to Gibraltar entry controls by the Gibraltar authorities, and then to Schengen entry controls by Spanish border authorities on behalf of the EU.

claims.claim_en: The old chain-link fence began coming down, but a new no-climb fence stands a few metres behind it; only about 150 metres is left open.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: As the old chain-link and barbed-wire fencing comes down, a new, high-security fence line has already been erected only a few metres away.
claims.ghi_chu: Thay thế neo Teardown "hàng rào gỡ 15/07".

claims.claim_en: The treaty says all physical barriers shall be removed according to an implementation plan.
claims.nguon: UK–EU Agreement in respect of Gibraltar, Art. 7 (MS No.9/2026)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: All physical barriers shall be removed in accordance with the implementation plan contained in the relevant administrative arrangement between the United Kingdom, in respect of Gibraltar, and the Kingdom of Spain.

claims.claim_en: After Brexit, Gibraltar was left outside the UK–EU trade deal, with no legal framework for its relations with the EU from January 2021.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Gibraltar was outside the scope of the UK-EUTrade & Cooperation Agreement (TCA), with the result that there has been no formal legal framework governing its relationship with the European Union (EU) since January 2021.
claims.ghi_chu: Nguyên văn có lỗi dính chữ "UK-EUTrade" từ tệp ODT.

claims.claim_en: The treaty does not make Gibraltar part of Schengen, the Single Market or the EU Customs Union; it builds a unique set of arrangements.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: It does not formally integrate Gibraltar into the Schengen Area, the EU Single Market, or the EU Customs Union, but creates a unique set of arrangements intended to achieve the benefits of a fluid land border between Gibraltar and Spain.

claims.claim_en: It creates a customs union between the EU and Gibraltar, so duties are paid at Gibraltar's port and airport instead of at the land border.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Customs duties will therefore not be applied at the land border. They will instead be applied to goods produced outside the EU upon entry into Gibraltar at one of the designated customs posts.

claims.claim_en: Gibraltar replaces import duty with a transaction tax of 15% this year, 16% next year, then expected 17%.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: This year the rate will be fixed at 15%. 879. Next year it will rise to 16%. 880. Then it will settle at a rate which is no lower than the lowest rate of VAT in the EU.
claims.nhay_cam: Cách gọi tên: Anh "not apply VAT" (Hansard 26/02/2026, Doughty) vs TBN "impuesto indirecto equivalente al IVA" (MAEUEC) — lời nêu cả hai.

claims.claim_en: Spain's foreign ministry describes it as an indirect tax equivalent to VAT; the UK says Gibraltar will not apply VAT.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: To be clear, Gibraltar will not apply VAT or any other sales tax, and its vital services industry will not be affected.
claims.nhay_cam: MÂU THUẪN tên gọi; đọc nguyên văn phía TBN trước G1 (phiên phụ chỉ trích "un impuesto indirecto equivalente al IVA, comenzando en un 15%").

claims.claim_en: The treaty says it does not affect either the UK's or Spain's legal position on sovereignty.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: shall be without prejudice to, and shall not otherwise affect, the respective legal positions of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland or of the Kingdom of Spain with regard to sovereignty and jurisdiction

claims.claim_en: In October 2025, 14,112 jobs in Gibraltar were held by people who live in Spain — more than four in ten of its 32,206 employee jobs.
claims.nguon: HMGoG Statistics Office, Employment Survey 2025 (Table 2.4, Summary)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: (a) Frontier Worker: an employee who is normally resident in Spain and is employed in Gibraltar. | In October 2025 the number of employee jobs was 32,206
claims.ghi_chu: 14 112/32 206 = 43,8 % (TỰ TÍNH). Đơn vị là việc làm, không phải người.

claims.claim_en: The UK Ministry of Defence accounts for about 500 of those jobs.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: The number of jobs in the MoD Sector showed an increase by 0.2% (1) over the year, to 500 in October 2025.

claims.claim_en: Of those cross-border jobs, 9,374 were held by Spanish nationals.
claims.ghi_chu: Hàng bảng: Public / MoD / Private / Total.

claims.claim_en: The UK government puts daily crossers at about 15,000, which it calls over half of Gibraltar's workforce.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: the 15,000 people – over half of Gibraltar’s workforce – who cross the land border between Spain and Gibraltar every day
claims.ghi_chu: Chỉ nói như lời của chính phủ Anh; số Thống kê Gibraltar (C08) là 43,8 % việc làm.

claims.claim_en: Gibraltar's economy grew from about £1.08 billion in 2010/11 to a forecast £3.09 billion in 2024/25.
Gibraltar's government puts output per resident at £85,145 this year — dividing forecast GDP by 38,200 residents.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: This year, dividing our forecast Gross Domestic Product across a resident population of 38,200, it stands at £85,145 per head.
claims.nhay_cam: Số tự công bố; luôn nói "Gibraltar's government says".

claims.claim_en: Its "third in the world" ranking converts pounds at a twenty-year average rate of $1.48, not today's rate.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: [2] Sterling figures are converted to US dollars at £1 = US$1.48, the twenty-year average sterling-to-dollar exchange rate

claims.claim_en: The Chief Minister himself says such comparisons are not an exact science.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: these international comparisons are not an exact science — they turn on differing national methodologies and on fluctuating exchange rates

claims.claim_en: The Statistics Office's own per-capita figure for 2024/25 is £80,885, revised after the 2022 census.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: 2024/25 (ii) 3,089.47 - 80,885 | (iii) From 2012/13 onwards GDP per Capita (factor cost) figures have been revised from previously published figures following the results of the 2022 Census of Gibraltar.

claims.claim_en: La Línea's unemployment rate was 28.6% in 2024 — the highest of the 113 Spanish cities in INE's urban indicators, against 11.34% nationally.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Línea de la Concepción, La. Tasa de desempleo (Porcentaje). Total. 2024: 28.6 | Total Nacional. Tasa de desempleo (Porcentaje). Total. 2024: 11.34
claims.ghi_chu: Xếp hạng 1/113 TỰ TÍNH từ bảng 69303. Là ước tính INE (EPA + sổ SEPE).

claims.claim_en: Net income per person in La Línea was €11,553 in 2023, against €14,807 for Spain as a whole.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Línea de la Concepción, La. Renta neta media anual por habitante (Euros). Total. 2023: 11553 | Total Nacional ... 2023: 14807

claims.claim_en: Spain's GDP per person was about €34,200 in 2025 (advance estimate).
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Producto interior bruto a precios de mercado per capita. Precios corrientes. 2025 = 34237.0
claims.ghi_chu: Số sơ bộ; không so trực tiếp với GDP giá yếu tố của Gibraltar mà không nêu khác biệt định nghĩa.

claims.claim_en: In 1704, during the War of the Spanish Succession, British and Dutch forces under Admiral Sir George Rooke and Prince George of Hesse-Darmstadt captured Gibraltar.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: British and Dutch forces, under Admiral Sir George Rooke and Prince George of Hesse-Darmstadt respectively, captured Gibraltar in 1704, during the War of the Spanish Succession.
claims.nhay_cam: TBN gọi là "militarily occupied" (A/AC.109/2025/8 §59). Không đọc ngày 4/8 (MÂU THUẪN nguồn).

claims.claim_en: Under the 1713 Treaty of Utrecht, Gibraltar was yielded to Britain "without any open communication by land with the country round about."
claims.nguon: UK Hansard HL Deb 15/02/1968 (đọc Điều X)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: be yielded to Great Britain without any territorial jurisdiction and without any open communication by land with the country round about.
claims.nhay_cam: CHỦ QUYỀN; bản dịch Anh TK18 đọc trong Hansard, không phải bản in hiệp ước.

claims.claim_en: In June 1969 Spain completely closed the land frontier; about 4,600 Spanish day workers could no longer reach their jobs.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: The Spanish authorities have now completely closed the land frontier with Gibraltar. About 4,600 Spanish day workers with jobs in Gibraltar are now prevented by their own Government from following the employment they have had

claims.claim_en: Pedestrians were partly let through from 15 December 1982; the frontier fully reopened on 5 February 1985.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: On 15th December 1982, the Spanish authorities partially opened the frontier for pedestrians [...] Spain opened its border on 5th February 1985.

claims.claim_en: Gibraltar measures 5.8 square kilometres by the UK's count; Spain, which disputes the isthmus, counts 4.8.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: According to the administering Power, the area of Gibraltar is 5.8 km2; according to Spain, which claims sovereignty over the Territory, it is 4.8 km2.
claims.nhay_cam: CHỦ QUYỀN. Bỏ số 6,8 km² của Teardown (không có nguồn chính thức).

claims.claim_en: Gibraltar's 2022 census counted 37,936 usual residents, the most ever recorded.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: On Census Day, 14 November 2022 the usually-resident population of Gibraltar was recorded as 37,936

claims.claim_en: On signing day both sides committed to countering harmful tax regimes, including zero or very low effective taxation, in line with OECD BEPS Action 5.
claims.nguon: Joint Declaration on countering harmful tax regimes, 14/07/2026
claims.trich_nguyen_van: If a tax regime meets the gateway criterion of imposing a significantly lower effective level of taxation than those levels which generally apply in the Participants, including zero taxation, it should be considered potentially harmful.
claims.nhay_cam: "Thiên đường thuế": chỉ nói bằng văn bản này + thuế suất (C22); không tự gán nhãn.

claims.claim_en: Gibraltar's standard corporation tax rate rose from 10% to 12.5% in 2021 and to 15% from 1 July 2024.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: The Corporation Tax rate for most companies in Gibraltar increased from 10% to 12.5% with effect from 1st August 2021 and then again to 15% with effect from 1st July 2024.

claims.claim_en: About 3,500 of Gibraltar's roughly 31,600 jobs were in gambling and betting in October 2024.
claims.nguon: UN Secretariat A/AC.109/2026/8 §32 (số liệu bên quản lý)
claims.trich_nguyen_van: 3,536 (2,091 male and 1,445 female) in gambling and betting activities
claims.ghi_chu: Employment Survey 2025: ngành giảm 78 việc làm (−2,2 %) tới 10/2025.

claims.claim_en: Gambling and betting jobs fell by 78 in the year to October 2025.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Specifically within the Other Service industry the largest decrease was recorded within the Gambling and betting activities sub-industry which fell by 2.2% (78).

claims.claim_en: Corporate tax receipts reached £252 million against an estimate of £170 million.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Corporate tax receipts reached £252 million against an estimate of £170 million.

claims.claim_en: In the 2016 referendum, 95.9% of Gibraltar's voters chose to remain in the EU: 19,322 to 823.
claims.nguon: UK Electoral Commission, EU referendum result data

claims.claim_en: The treaty is only provisionally applied; the European Parliament still has to consent, with a vote indicated for 14 December 2026.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: The European Parliament will need to give its consent, in accordance with the EU treaties. [...] Indicative plenary sitting date is set for 14 December 2026.
claims.nhay_cam: Thời sự đổi được; "as of" bắt buộc.

claims.claim_en: Either side can end the treaty with 12 months' written notice.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: It provides that the Treaty can be terminated by either the UK or EU by written notification, with termination taking effect 12 months after the notification.

claims.claim_en: If Gibraltar refuses a recommended change to its indirect tax rates, the EU may apply Spanish VAT and excise at the border.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: should Gibraltar refuse to change its rates following a recommendation, the EU may, upon the conclusion of consultations with Gibraltar authorities, apply Spanish rates of VAT and excise duty at the border.

claims.claim_en: Britain's constitutional pledge: Gibraltarians will never pass under another state's sovereignty against their freely and democratically expressed wishes.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Her Majesty’s Government will never enter into arrangements under which the people of Gibraltar would pass under the sovereignty of another state against their freely and democratically expressed wishes
claims.nhay_cam: CHỦ QUYỀN — luôn đi cặp với C30.

claims.claim_en: Spain holds that Utrecht ceded only the town, castle, port and fortifications, and that the isthmus has always remained Spanish.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: El istmo, al igual que las aguas adyacentes o el espacio aéreo suprayacente, no fue cedido por España y ha permanecido siempre bajo soberanía española.
claims.nhay_cam: CHỦ QUYỀN — luôn đi cặp với C29.

claims.claim_en: In 1967, 12,138 Gibraltarians voted to keep the link with Britain and 44 for Spanish sovereignty.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: 12,138 were in favour of retaining the link with Britain while 44 voted for Spanish sovereignty.
claims.nhay_cam: TBN viện dẫn Nghị quyết ĐHĐ LHQ 2353 (XXII) — nêu cả hai.

claims.claim_en: The UN still lists Gibraltar as a Non-Self-Governing Territory administered by the UK.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Gibraltar is a Non-Self-Governing Territory administered by the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.

claims.claim_en: The runway was built across the only road to Spain in 1941; since 31 March 2023 cars use a tunnel, while people on foot still cross the runway.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: The Gibraltar Airport runway was built across it in 1941, and incorporated vehicular and pedestrian routes to and from the frontier.
claims.nhay_cam: TBN coi việc chiếm eo đất (nơi có sân bay) là bất hợp pháp — không bình luận.

claims.claim_en: A joint venture set up outside Spain will pick a company to run the airport, which will open to direct EU flights.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: The provisions on aviation (Articles 271–275) allow for direct flights between Gibraltar and airports in the EU. They also provide for the establishment of a joint venture company established between Gibraltar and Spain.

claims.claim_en: Average gross annual earnings in Gibraltar reached £39,511 in October 2025.
claims.trich_nguyen_van: Average gross annual earnings in respect of all employee jobs increased by 5.8%, from £37,332.42 in October 2024 to £39,510.9 in October 2025.
